parsed.name: Kepco BOP 20-20M 双极性可编程电源/电流源
parsed.name_en: Kepco BOP 20-20M Bipolar Programmable Power Supply / Current Source
parsed.description: Kepco BOP 20-20M 是一款双极性可编程电源，可作为受控电流源使用，并支持测量电流、电压及电阻等量。在实验室中常用于为器件提供正负双向激励、进行电学表征和 I-V/R 测量。
parsed.description_en: The Kepco BOP 20-20M is a bipolar programmable power supply that can be used as a controlled current source and can measure current, voltage, and resistance-related quantities. In the lab it is commonly used to apply positive and negative electrical excitation to devices and for electrical characterization such as I-V and resistance measurements.
